s.note: Ahmad's plan to get everyone back for Sunday
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet relish and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and dust with paprika.

s.n: Big Mama's ham hock braised greens
s.how: Simmer a smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with a sliced onion, 3 garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes for 1 hour. Add 2 bunches kale or collards, stems removed and chopped, and braise gently for 90 minutes. Pick the meat off the hock and stir it back in. Finish with 2 tbsp cider vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of the pot liquor.

m.note: the heart of every Sunday dinner
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk and 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour with 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Fry in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.

w.note: the dessert at the end of every Sunday
w.how: Cook 6 sliced peaches with 40g butter, 80g brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg for 5 minutes. Tip into a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over. Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes.

d.note: the big jug on the table
d.how: Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with a pinch of bicarb for 5 minutes. Stir in 80g sugar while hot and cool. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80g sugar and 500ml cold water. Mix the tea and lemonade in a big jug with ice, lemon wheels and mint, and pour.
